query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, x."口径", x."收益率（%）" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('隐含收益率', round((v.implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('现金支持口径', round((v.cash_implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('要求收益率', round((v.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2))) x("口径", "收益率（%）") ORDER BY v.sort, 2

SELECT x.price AS "买入价", '隐含收益率' AS "系列", round((vi_irr(f.divs, f.taus, f.td, f.ttau, f.cf_g, x.price) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "收益率" FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) UNION ALL SELECT x.price, '要求收益率', round((f.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM vi_valuation_cf f JOIN vi_scenario_base s ON s.id = f.scenario_id AND s.is_base JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_calc cc ON cc.id = m.company_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(greatest(1, floor(cc.latest_price * 0.5))::int, ceil(cc.latest_price * 1.6)::int) x(price) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT h.year, round(h.volume::numeric, CASE WHEN h.volume < 100 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS "业务量" FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE h.volume IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year
SELECT h.year, round((h.price*100)::numeric, 3) AS "收入转化率" FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE h.price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year

SELECT left(d.period, 4) AS period, d.line_item AS "项目", round(d.value::numeric, 0) AS "亿元" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE d.period_kind = '时点' AND d.period LIKE '%Q4' AND d.period >= '2019' AND d.line_item IN ('应收账款＋合同资产', '应付票据及应付账款') UNION ALL SELECT h.year::text, '营业收入', round(h.revenue::numeric, 0) FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE h.year >= 2019 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.period, round(d.value::numeric, 1) AS "减值" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE d.line_item = '资产及信用减值损失' AND d.period_kind = '全年' AND d.period >= '2019' ORDER BY d.period_end

SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润', h.np_parent), ('分红总额', h.dividend_total)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('经营现金流', h.cfo), ('资本开支', h.capex)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year, x.item, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS pct FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', h.gross_margin), ('ROE', h.roe)) x(item, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year::text AS year, '历史' AS kind, round(h.interest_debt::numeric, 0) AS debt FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' WHERE h.interest_debt IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.year::text, '预测', round(fc.debt_close::numeric, 0) FROM vi_forecast_base f JOIN vi_forecast_calc fc USING (id) JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = f.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' ORDER BY year
SELECT o.obs_date,o.value AS 股价 FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.price_metric_id=o.metric_id WHERE co.code='601668.SH' ORDER BY o.obs_date
SELECT f.dimension AS "维度", f.score AS "评分" FROM vi_fit_score_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '601668.SH' ORDER BY f.sort, f.id
